decisions.reason: The request for a complete, consistently versioned template package does not change the separate obligation to explain how the Master template tables function.
Package completeness and the _24 filename suffix do not alter the required copy-paste behavior or stability standard.
The source changes delivery-package completeness and naming only; it does not revise bullet appearance, sizing, spacing, alignment, or variants.
The complete-package and version-suffix request does not change column containment or text-box wrapping behavior.
Packaging all templates as version _24 does not change the Master template's role as the foundation for derived templates.
The source does not alter numbered-list alignment behavior or its multi-digit acceptance condition.
The delivery-package request does not change the requirement for reliable manual line-break entry after pasted content.
The _24 suffix applies to delivered template filenames, not to internal Word style names, their PBU prefix, or their language.
Requesting every template in a complete _24 package does not modify the specified style system or its application coverage.
The source does not resolve or modify the table-paste layout requirement or its existing technical ambiguity.
The source does not change or resolve the required Tab-driven list hierarchy behavior.
Package completeness and filename versioning do not alter the supported Word environment or operational-reliability requirement.
